newsitem.title: IRAQ: Saddam reviews Iraq's missile deployment.
newsitem.headline: Saddam reviews Iraq's missile deployment.

text.p: President Saddam Hussein discussed the deployment of Iraq's surface-to-air missile forces on Saturday with senior military aides, the official Iraqi News Agency INA reported.

"President Saddam Hussein chaired a meeting which included the commander and staff of the (Iraqi) air defence (forces)... the meeting discussed the deployment of our surface-to-air missile forces and the registeration of lessons derived from the battle of the third return (a reference to the U.S. missile strike on September 3 and 4 on Iraq)," INA said.
On Friday, Iraq said it would suspend its attacks on U.S. and allied warplanes flying over its north and south but vowed to retaliate if it was attacked by the United States.

"The meeting discussed...the improvement of confrontation means in the face of any evil possibility that would be necessitated by the future if Almighty wants that, or Satan pushes the enemy into his vicious abysses," INA said.
